subject: Next steps: On-prem readiness workshop & access details
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Ortiz <danielle@asterhealth.com>
Cc: nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: proposed on-prem readiness workshop + artifacts

Hi Danielle —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Discovery highlights: AsterHealth wants a private (VPC/on-prem) deploy for patient data processing, short inference tails for triage workflows, and integration with Okta SSO + your KMS.
- Key risks we flagged: network egress constraints, certificate rotation process, and an internal firewall that blocks dynamic VPN endpoints.

Recommended next step: a 90-minute On‑Prem Readiness Workshop (technical deep dive) with your infra, security, and a networking engineer on the call. We’ll cover: architecture map, access requirements, temporary test access (VPN jumpbox), and a preflight checklist for procurement.

Proposed 90-min slots (PDT):
- Tue May 4 — 10:00–11:30
- Thu May 6 — 13:00–14:30
- Fri May 7 — 08:00–09:30

Please confirm which slot works or suggest alternatives. Also helpful if you can share: the name/email of the person who manages firewall/IP allowlists, and whether we should expect a corporate proxy that inspects TLS.

Attaching a short preflight checklist and a networking template to make the calendar ask easier.

Thanks — we’ll tailor the agenda once you confirm attendees.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0179

Attachments: redwood_onprem_checklist.pdf (4 pages), networking_preflight.csv (template)
From: Danielle Ortiz <danielle@asterhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AsterHealth IT Procurement <itprocure@asterhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: proposed on-prem readiness workshop + artifacts

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. We are definitely interested in moving forward with the workshop. A couple quick notes from our side:

- Firewall/IP owner: Robert Lin (robert.lin@asterhealth.com) — please include him so he can confirm allowlist windows.
- We prefer the Thu May 6 slot but can do Tue May 4 if necessary.
- For Okta SSO we’ll need a short pre-call to validate relying-party metadata — can that be a 20-min pre-check with your identity engineer?

I’ll confirm the final attendee list after I check calendars, but the expected participants from AsterHealth: myself (product), Robert (networking), and Carla (security).

Thanks,
Danielle
Senior Product Manager | AsterHealth
danielle@asterhealth.com

Thanks Danielle — Thu May 6 looks good from our side. A couple internal notes we should call out before the 90‑min workshop:

- Action: schedule a 20-min IDP/SSO pre-check the week before (I’ll own coordinating Redwood’s identity engineer).
- Ben, please scope a short networking runbook we can send to Robert ahead of time (expected: NTP, DNS, IP ranges, and cert thumbprint fingerprints).
- We’ll request temporary SSH jumpbox credentials for the workshop lab; confirm whether AsterHealth prefers a VPN or a bastion host.

Marissa — can you send a calendar invite for Thu May 6 at 13:00 PDT and attach the agenda doc (we’ll include the preflight checklist and networking template)? I’ll add me + Ben + our infra eng.

Agenda highlights (will be editable in Drive):
- Introductions & scope alignment (10)
- Network & access requirements (25)
- Deployment topology & KMS integration (20)
- Test access + sample inference run (20)
- Next steps / procurement checklist (15)

Danielle — I’ve uploaded the agenda and a lightweight lab guide here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_onprem-workshop-agenda. Robert — if you can provide an IP allowlist window and confirm whether a proxy inspects TLS, we’ll lock down the temporary access method.
